name: Leek

schedule.notes: Trim tops to 3 in periodically to thicken stems.
Drop into 6 in deep dibble holes; don't fill — water in. Hilling later blanches the shaft.
Pull as needed, well into winter under mulch in zone 6+.

harvest.cues: Shafts 1 in+ thick, white portion 4+ in long. Lift with a fork to avoid breaking.
harvest.storageNotes: Roots-on in damp sand or fridge 2 to 4 weeks. Frozen sliced for soups.

varieties.name: Bandit
varieties.notes: Cold-hardy, dark blue-green tops. Will overwinter in zones 7+.

notes: Plant deep in dibbled holes to grow the long white shaft. Carrots make the classic companion — alleged to mask each other's pests.
